# SUSHI-generated files

Do not hand-edit files generated from `sushi-config.yaml` or `input/fsh`; rerun SUSHI after
changing those sources.

| Generated file | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `fsh-generated/resources/ImplementationGuide-hl7.fhir.au.base.json` | `sushi-config.yaml` |
| `fsh-generated/resources/*.json` | `input/fsh/**/*.fsh` |
| `fsh-generated/data/fsh-index.json` and `fsh-generated/fsh-index.txt` | `input/fsh/**/*.fsh` |
| `fsh-generated/includes/fsh-link-references.md` | `input/fsh/**/*.fsh` |
| `fsh-generated/includes/menu.xml` | `sushi-config.yaml` |
